info.title: Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy
info.synopsis: Kanan è un demone che si nasconde in un liceo nel mondo umano per cibarsi delle loro anime. Ha concentrato tutta la sua attenzione su un singolo studente, ma in qualche modo stipula un contratto amoroso con lui?! Kanan, che non si è mai innamorata, sta scoprendo nuovi sentimenti!

episodes.title: Kanan`s Easy
episodes.synopsis: The devil Kanan has been cultivating humans to eat their souls... until one of them ends up as her boyfriend.

episodes.title: Ami Has Arrived
episodes.synopsis: Kanan's maid, Ami, has come to check on her and snack on all the cute humans.

episodes.title: Kanan`s First Date
episodes.synopsis: After catching Kyougi with his old friend, Kanan finds the courage to ask him out on a date that goes awry.

episodes.title: Ami the Forceful Cupid
episodes.synopsis: Ami arranges all kinds of ploys to try and get Kanan and Kyougi to finally kiss.

episodes.title: Kanan and the Saint
episodes.synopsis: Jeanne, a saint, arrives from Heaven to protect Kyougi from devils but proves to be unintentionally seductive.

episodes.title: Kanan`s First Time Skipping
episodes.synopsis: After some embarrassing events leave Kanan flustered, Kyougi skips school to take her on a beach date.

episodes.title: Kanan`s Summer Break
episodes.synopsis: Kanan tutors Kyougi and Nadeko. Nadeko lusts for Kanan's scorn. All the girls shop for swimsuits together.

episodes.title: Kanan Returns to Her Family
episodes.synopsis: Kanan introduces Kyougi to her family, and they work on getting approval for their relationship.

episodes.title: Lilim`s Test of Defeat
episodes.synopsis: Kyougi and Kanan learn how Lilim met Kanan's father, then Lilim tests their relationship with her seduction.

episodes.title: Milch`s Bratty Memories
episodes.synopsis: Jeanne comes clean. Kyougi learns about Milch's true feelings.

episodes.title: Miel`s Stolen Love
episodes.synopsis: Kyougi and Kanan take Miel to the lakeside with them to try and earn her stamp of approval.

episodes.title: Kanan and Kyougi`s Trial of Love
episodes.synopsis: Kanan and Kyougi play beach volleyball to earn Beelzebub's final stamp of approval.

info.title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: A Lonely Dragon Wants to be Loved
info.synopsis: La quotidianità serena di Kobayashi e delle draghe viene improvvisamente interrotta dall'arrivo di una presenza antica e potente, Kimun Kamui, leggendario drago del chaos e padre di Kanna. Il suo ritorno riporta a galla vecchi conflitti e un passato che Kanna non ha mai davvero conosciuto. Costretta a confrontarsi con le proprie origini, Kanna si ritrova divisa tra il mondo dei draghi, che reclama il suo ritorno, e la vita umana che le ha insegnato cosa significhi essere amata, mentre le tensioni tra le fazioni draconiche crescono, i legami costruiti con Kobayashi, Tohru e gli altri vengono messi alla prova.

info.title: Crowned in a Hundred Days
info.synopsis: Un massacro svela un re impostore. Ming si allea col vero re Lie per reclamare il trono prima che non ci sia più tempo per farlo.

episodes.title: The 100-Day Kingship Plan Begins
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoming comes up with the brilliant idea of creating a special menu in honor of King Lie.

episodes.title: Illiteracy Ruins the Magic Lesson
episodes.synopsis: After merging, Xiaoming and Lie must find a way to achieve their respective goals.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Grimoire Appears
episodes.synopsis: On a mission to find a spellbook, Xiaoming tries out to become a cook.

episodes.title: A Recipe Too Awful to Watch
episodes.synopsis: Head Chef Ramsay wants to uncover the secret behind Xiaoming's recipe and sets a trap for him.

episodes.title: Not a Duel, Just a Stiff Neck
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoming must prove he memorized the entire spellbook, but his stiff neck won't make it easy.

episodes.title: King Lie's Cover Blown Too Soon!
episodes.synopsis: To conquer the kingdom, Xiaoming and company must win the hearts of the people.

episodes.title: Reborn as the Ultimate Wealthy Tycoon
episodes.synopsis: Liang will stop at nothing to put Xiaoming out of business and save his own.

episodes.title: Girls Really Are Brave and Adorable!
episodes.synopsis: A dangerous prisoner has escaped from the dungeons, and it seems he has a very clear mission.

episodes.title: Kids, If You Like Someone, Be Bold and Confess!
episodes.synopsis: They discover Xiaoming's power to create bread. Lei Wan gets him drunk, causing destructive, magical burps.

episodes.title: Touch My People and You Die!
episodes.synopsis: Because he helped Xiaoming, Ba comes into conflict with the Captain of the Guard.

episodes.title: Look Up! There's Gold in the Sky!
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoming infiltrates the guard post using the captain's corpse and discovers a massive treasure.

episodes.title: Snagging the District Chief Title!
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoming wants to buy the District 10 Chief position and discovers just how corrupt the bureaucracy is.

episodes.title: Reviving District 10
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoming and Lie seek a way for a district as poor and corrupt as District 10 to prosper.

episodes.title: Magic for the Masses
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoming finds a spell for transferring magic, but doesn't know how to perform it.

episodes.title: Hero Saves the Beauty?! What a Cliché Plot!
episodes.synopsis: The new mages are beginning their training.

episodes.title: Then How About a Taste of My Fist?!
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoming face an enemy immune to magic and physical blows.

episodes.title: Every Show of Support is a Battle!
episodes.synopsis: Xiaoming tries to revive Liang, and Lei Wan faces an unexpected attack.

episodes.title: The Miraculous Cure
episodes.synopsis: Huang attempts to save Liang, and Xiaoming will have to deal with the death of the District 9 Chief.

episodes.title: Who Am I?! I'm Your Big Bro!
episodes.synopsis: Qin Tian wants to see the Chief of District 9, and Xiaoming will have to find a way to deceive him.

episodes.title: Conspiracy
episodes.synopsis: A giant castle in a mysterious world. Two shady Majin, Gomah and Degesu, watch a monitor. The monitor shows Goku and the others having a fierce battle against Majin Buu. Gomah and Degesu head to Earth to execute a certain conspiracy.

episodes.title: Glorio
episodes.synopsis: Goku and his friends have been turned small due to Gomah's scheme. They begin preparing to go to the demon world. Goku collects his Nyoibo and looks forward to a new adventure. Then the mysterious young Majin Glorio appears!

episodes.title: Daima
episodes.synopsis: Goku, Supreme Kai, and Glorio head out to the "Demon Realm" first. Their plane travels through space and a mysterious dimension. They arrive at the entrance to the Demon Realm, the "Third Demon World"!

episodes.title: Chatty
episodes.synopsis: Forced to make their way through the Third Demon World on foot, Goku and his companions stop by a lone drive-in on the way. There they encounter some strange souvenirs and a rather chatty and quirky Majin woman and her husband!

episodes.title: Panzy
episodes.synopsis: The masked Majin who appeared before Goku and his companions is a young girl named Panzy! While Glorio gives her the cold shoulder, Panzy insists on acting as their guide. The group reaches a suspicious castle!

episodes.title: Lightning
episodes.synopsis: After encountering the Gendarmerie, the wardens of the Demon Realm, the four are forced to camp in a cave where they encounter further trouble! The enigmatic Glorio unleashes lightning magic against Goku to resolve the situation!

episodes.title: Collar
episodes.synopsis: Goku and his companions continue their journey. But the Gendarmerie appear and bar their way again, perhaps due to them knowing the location of the Magic Collar around Panzy's neck. Can the bond with her friends save Panzy from peril?!

episodes.title: Tamagami
episodes.synopsis: The fight with a Tamagami begins! The Tamagamis are the undefeated guardians of the Dragon Balls. Seeing Goku fight toe-to-toe with one, Panzy and the others are unable to hide their surprise. As the battle heats up, what will happen?!

episodes.title: Thieves
episodes.synopsis: Rumors of what Goku did in the Third Demon World spread across the Demon Realm. To avoid trouble, Goku wears a disguise at the hotel, but they can't let their guard down in the Third Demon World. Thieves see through his disguise!

episodes.title: Ocean
episodes.synopsis: Goku and his companions arrive at the mystic Second Demon World where a giant ocean spreads as far as the eye can see! The party is amazed at the new world but is immediately attacked by Gendarmerie that have been sent by Gomah!

episodes.title: Legend
episodes.synopsis: Having regrouped with Vegeta and the others, Goku and his companions arrive at a planet that seems familiar. As they move to head out, a suspicious shadow approaches! It's the Legendary Namek who remained alone in the Demon Realm!

episodes.title: True Strength
episodes.synopsis: Vegeta’s battle with the Tamagami is evenly matched, but forced underwater where he's not used to fighting, he finds himself struggling! Vegeta is cornered and sinks to the ocean floor. But then he finally unleashes his true strength!

info.title: L'incantevole Creamy - Il ritorno di Creamy (ITA)
info.synopsis: Sembra che la carriera musicale di Creamy Mami sia finita per sempre. E invece no! Perché qualcuno sta preparando un concerto come non se ne sono mai visti, per celebrare l'anniversario del debutto della cantante. Ma chi ha messo in giro la voce che Creamy sia tornata? E che cos'è che compare nel cielo sopra il palcoscenico?
